Just as it says... what's your most valued (either monetarily or sentimentally) vinyl in your collection.

For me, it's my originaly Pink Floyd - Animals. It was given to me by a good friend and I knew it was an album that he listened to often. There was really no good reason for him to give it to me other than he knew how much I loved the album. Sure, I could have found it in a bin somewhere or on Discogs, and though it's not worth much in dollars, it means that much more to me because it was gifted to me with some serious selflessness.
[META} Name the prized item in your collection.

Keep this friend close man!

My most monetarily valued LP is Nine Inch Nails' The Fragile. I love the album and would never sell it. My most sentimentally vinyl is probably The Gathering's Nighttime Birds. I was into metal shit in my teenage years. Nowadays, I'm into blues but I keep getting back to this one regularly. The singer's voice is just crystal and amazing.

Value wise it is Venetian Snares - Rossz Csillag Alatt Született. It's valued somewhere above $60 and it's out of print.

Sentimentally, definitely Aphex Twin - Selected Ambient Works 85-92. It's the album that got me into real music, and I've listened to it far more than any other work.

Oh my yes. This was the album that made me pull my head out of my ass and start hording all the Warp stuff on vinyl. I was under the silly impression electronica was as good as it gets on quality digital media. Hearing this on a quality tt setup was like hearing it for the first time again. If you dig Boards of Canada any of their LP's and EP's are absolute musts. So many details pop out on vinyl that you just don't get otherwise.

Meshuggah's first 1989 EP - Psykisk Testbild. I've been trying to collect their entire vinyl discography and finally found someone willing to part with it on discogs. Now I'm just looking for Chaosphere.

Runner up would be Extol's ~300 press Synergy picture disk. Extol was such a huge influence in my musical journey when I was younger. I would kill for a pressing of Burial or Undeceived.

Depeche Mode - Songs of Faith and Devotion. Cousin got it for me for my birthday.

LFO - LFO Found a white label release of this in Amoeba for $20.
